fact: BCEAO Instruction n° 020, signed 8 October 2026 and in force 2 November 2026, amends the rules for e-money issuers, setting a 4 million CFA franc holding cap, a 15 million monthly reload cap and at least 65 percent of outstanding e-money in sight deposits.
title: UMOA : la BCEAO relève les plafonds de monnaie électronique et encadre les placements
